entries.title: New work starts on the computer your directions name
entries.body: When more than one of your computers can run a new task, your decision model reads your standing directions and picks where it starts, or waits for that computer to have room. Follow-up tasks also start beside the work they came from. If no direction says which computer to use, the usual rules choose. Choose a computer for new work is on unless you switch it off under Decisions.

picture.alt: The Decisions group with Jev answering, and a Uses list where Choose a computer for new work sits switched on between Propose standing direction and Screen automation events
